notes.title: Ver. 0.5.1 available now!!
notes.content:
Hi Guys, the new update is released!

[b]New Map[/b]

The new map will be replaced in the new update, we are working to make it as realistic as possible!

[IMG]http://i67.tinypic.com/2ym7s0l.png[/IMG]

[b]Player Name Added[/b]

Now while in game you can select your name at will!

[IMG]http://i66.tinypic.com/2vhysjn.png[/IMG]

[b]Updated graphics settings[/b]

In the moment the graphics quality settings to improve them have been removed since some users have had problems, you can still select when the game starts!

[b]New MatchMaking menù[/b]

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/20ic7t3.png[/IMG]

P.S. New map has been added, in the next update will add the selection of maps, the first map will be available again.

[b]Some users have reported that when you start the game you will find one virus called "Assembly-CSharp", is not a virus, is a Microsoft file, some antivirus detect it. IS NOT DANGEROUS[/b]
Good Game                  -OblionStudio ːblobberː
